title: Gradient ramp and toon gradient map textures
purpose: Sample colour stops into an RGBA8 ramp interpolated in linear light, smooth or stepped, stored sRGB-encoded for colour or linear for data, and wrap it as a three.js DataTexture with the matching colour space and filtering, including MeshToonMaterial gradient maps. Use it for colour ramps, palettes and toon bands.

engine.name: webgl2_browser
engine.notes: gradientRamp and sampleGradient need no three.js; the texture builders take three.js r152 or later as THREE (colorSpace); only 0.186.1 was run.

exports.name: gradientRamp
exports.summary: RGBA8 bytes, width texels, texel i at t = (i + 0.5) / width.

exports.name: sampleGradient
exports.signature: sampleGradient(stops, t, options = {}) -> [r, g, b, a]
exports.summary: The gradient at t as linear light.

exports.name: createGradientTexture
exports.summary: width x 1 texture; SRGBColorSpace or NoColorSpace by encoding; NearestFilter when stepped.

exports.name: createToonGradientMap
exports.summary: MeshToonMaterial.gradientMap with one nearest-filtered texel per linear level.

exports.name: linearToSrgb
exports.summary: Linear light to an sRGB-encoded component.

exports.name: GRADIENT_DEFAULTS
exports.summary: Frozen default options: width 256, mode smooth, input srgb, encoding srgb.

contract.stops: [{position: 0..1 (not decreasing), color: 0xRRGGBB or [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a] in 0..1}]

options.name: mode
options.meaning: Interpolate between stops, or hold each stop until the next.

options.name: input
options.meaning: How stop colours are read: sRGB-encoded (as colour pickers and hex numbers give them) or already linear.

options.name: encoding
options.meaning: How bytes are stored: sRGB for colour textures, linear for gradient maps and data.

limits: Piecewise linear interpolation in linear-light sRGB: no perceptual spaces such as OKLab, no easing between stops and no dithering, so long dark ramps can band in 8 bits. Alpha is interpolated linearly and stored unpremultiplied. The input setting applies to hex numbers and arrays alike. The textures are one texel high, without mipmaps. MeshToonMaterial reads only the red channel of a gradient map. Only three.js 0.186.1 was run, in headless Chrome on SwiftShader WebGL 2.
technique_references: Step gradient maps for toon shading
